name: Silent Horizon
storyline:
Who will you be?
You’ve spent years on the road. Is seemingly perfect Rusty Eden the place to finally settle down, or just another stop along the way? Decide quickly. Another wave of the Red Fog is coming.

Make friends… or not
Rusty Eden is a bustling trading town, and right now it’s crowded with outsiders: raiders, cultists, mercenaries, preachers and couriers. Every faction wants the town for itself. Side with one, play them against each other, or make enemies of them all. Your choices decide who trusts you, and what becomes of the people who live here.

The Fog is coming. You’d better be ready.
The Red Fog swallowed most of the world, and no one knows where it came from. It comes and goes like the tide, and it brings monsters with it. Those who walk into it rarely come back, and the ones who do are never quite the same. Now it’s at Rusty Eden’s gates, and it seems to be paying attention to you.
summary: A turn-based RPG where post-apocalypse meets dark western and weird fiction. The Red Fog that ended the Old World has sealed you inside Rusty Eden. Navigate rival factions, carve out a place for yourself, and uncover what the Fog really is.
